description: This file contains utility functions for managing picklist fields in the vtiger CRM system, including retrieving picklist values, modules, roles, and handling permissions for picklist entries.
external_files: vtiger CRM database connection and utility functions (implied via global $adb)

methods.name: getUserFldArray
methods.description: Retrieves picklist field details for a specific module and role, including labels, types, and values.

methods.name: getPickListModules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that have picklist values, excluding disabled modules.

methods.name: getrole2picklist
methods.description: Returns all roles in the CRM except for role 'H1', for use in picklist permissions.

methods.name: get_available_module_picklist
methods.description: Returns available picklist fields for a module with translated labels.

methods.name: getAllPickListValues
methods.description: Fetches all picklist values for a given field, optionally with language translations.

methods.name: getEditablePicklistValues
methods.description: Returns all editable picklist values for a specific field.

methods.name: getNonEditablePicklistValues
methods.description: Returns all non-editable picklist values for a specific field.

methods.name: getAssignedPicklistValues
methods.description: Returns picklist values assigned to a role and its subordinates.
